movelist.name: Aqua Ring
movelist.effect: Aqua Ring covers the user in a Coat that heals the user at the beginning of their turn. The user is healed a Tick of Hit Points each turn.

movelist.name: Safeguard
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Safeguard may activate it when receiving a Status Affliction to ignore the effects of that Status Affliction on their next turn. Safeguard may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Captivate
movelist.effect: Captivate lowers the target’s Special Attack 2 Combat Stages. Captivate may not affect something that is the same gender as the user or something that is genderless.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

movelist.name: Rain Dance
movelist.effect: The weather becomes Rainy for 5 rounds. While Rainy, Water-Type Attacks gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls, and Fire-Type Attacks suffer a -5 Damage penalty.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.trigger: A foe of the opposite gender attacks the user
